# The Eagles SIS Admin Portal

> Authenticated operations portal for administrators and teachers managing student records, enrollment, attendance, grades, assignments, parent reports, news reports, and notification queues for The Eagles American English Club.

This portal is for authorized staff only. It uses cookie-based sessions; API routes under `/api/admin` are not public documentation endpoints and require an authenticated session. Do not infer student, family, credential, or school-configuration data from an unauthenticated response.

## Portal

- [Admin portal](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/admin): Staff login and the operations dashboard.
- [Portal hub](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/): Entry point for staff, parent, and student portals.

## Capabilities

- Student roster, profiles, identity validation, and imports.
- Enrollment periods and student enrollment operations.
- Attendance, assignments, grades, performance, and report-card workflows.
- Parent report and news-report review queues.
- Email notification queues and assignment reminders.
- Role-aware access for `admin` and read-only `teacher` users.
- Runtime health, school setup, permissions, and controlled service operations for authorized admins.

## API

- [Admin API](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/api/admin): Cookie-session API prefix for authenticated staff operations.
- [Admin login](https://admin.eagles.edu.vn/api/admin/auth/login): `POST` login endpoint; credentials must never be included in prompts or generated links.
